transcript.text: Hello everyone, thank you for being here. As you know, the family has asked me to coordinate a small lakeside memorial for their grandmother, and I'm holding the ashes that will be placed in the water during the ceremony. Before I settle on the final plan, I'd like to hear from each of you — your needs, any relevant updates, and anything else we should consider regarding the place, timing, ceremony materials, or the dedication. The gathering will be brief, so let's work together to make sure it's meaningful and works for everyone.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Everyone, I have something important to share. I have Grandma's handwritten note. In it she says, 'Please let me rest at Willow Point,' and she asks the family to use the dedication words 'Love keeps finding its way home.' I should have brought this up sooner, but I wanted us all to be together when I shared it.

transcript.text: I need to share something important about my mobility. My hip makes stairs and steep slopes unsafe, so I need to use the north paved trail rather than the south path to reach the memorial site. I want to make sure wherever we settle on is accessible for me.

transcript.text: I should have mentioned this sooner, but a county ranger told me that ashes may only be placed at Willow Point between 10:00 and 12:00 on the Saturday we're planning. I haven't passed that timing information along to the family yet, but I think it's important everyone knows now, especially since Marcus just shared that Grandma specifically requested Willow Point.

The crematory told me that the temporary plastic container they're in should not be used for the water ceremony — the ashes need to be transferred into a water-soluble urn first. I haven't passed that instruction along to the group yet, but since Elena is planning the ceremony materials, I think it's critical everyone knows now.

commitments.detail: Confirm the Saturday 10:00–12:00 window with the county ranger and ensure the family is notified of the timing.
Obtain a water-soluble urn and coordinate with Elena to transfer the ashes before the ceremony.
Ensure the route to Willow Point via the north paved trail is confirmed accessible and free of obstacles before the memorial day.
Bring Grandma's handwritten note to the memorial so the family can see her request firsthand.
